qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While Sodexo possesses global catering scale, its multi-year GAAP ROIC (6-8%) and operating margins (3-5%) consistently fall far short of the 12% hurdle. Lacks the food procurement scale and execution efficiency of Compass Group, with returns diluted by facilities management.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Proof of Moat). Despite global contract catering presence, 5-year GAAP ROIC sits at ~6-8% and operating margins at 3.3-4.7%, well below the 12% hurdle. Lags peer Compass Group substantially in North American procurement scale, operating efficiency, and contractual pricing leverage.
qualitative.evidence: Reported GAAP ROIC was 6.1% in FY23 and 7.7% in FY24, with operating profit margins hovering between 3.3% and 4.7%. Even after spinning off high-margin voucher business Pluxee in early 2024, core on-site catering and facilities management fail to demonstrate economic moat returns.
